root_cause: Original tenant runtime mapper used healthy !== false and status defaults of ok for absent measurements, graph nodes, non-blocked agent activity, observed audit records and low-risk governance. Revoked or failed provider reads could clear transient state without dispatching native page invalidation or leave prior state visible on transport errors.
fix: Conservative explicit-proof status mapping, and one existing runtime event on same-session unauthorized or unavailable source invalidation; only transient derived runtime is cleared, customer input state and unsaved forms remain untouched.
prevention_rules: Unknown source health or a graph/audit/activity record must not imply healthy integration, executed action or compliance.
On unauthorized/unavailable original tenant runtime readback clear same-principal derived projection and publish original invalidation once.
Do not mutate customer-input state, cross tenant boundaries, or discard unsaved DOM forms for read-model recovery.
Reject overall green until authenticated A/B input -> Brain -> Powerhouse -> Heartbeat -> action -> verified outcome -> learning is provider-proven.
